text: Viktor Quinlan starred for Kingsmoor FC, scoring two early goals including a penalty at 8 minutes and a clever goal at 12 minutes after a long team pass build-up [#152] [#222]. Westport Albion's Rafael Delacroix answered back with two amazing goals before half-time, showing fast and direct play [#401] [#553]. The game stayed super-close with both teams trading goals, ending in a thrilling 3-3 tie. Kingsmoor’s Luca Iversen scored a late goal just after a red card made it harder for Kingsmoor, proving they never gave up [#1495] [#1516]. Both teams showed great teamwork, with Kingsmoor playing wide and crossing the ball a lot, while Westport used fast, straight passes to attack [#222] [#553]. It was a match full of exciting moments and good football skills!
